findings.issue: Worker Dockerfile missing HEALTHCHECK directive â€” API and web have it
findings.impact: Container orchestrator cannot detect worker process hang or crash; unhealthy worker may silently stop processing jobs
findings.fix: Add HEALTHCHECK --interval=30s --timeout=5s --retries=3 CMD wget --no-verbose --tries=1 --spider http://localhost:4100/healthz || exit 1

findings.issue: Dockerfiles use `node:22-alpine` without SHA digest pinning â€” base image tag is mutable
findings.impact: Builds may produce different images over time as node:22-alpine is updated; supply chain integrity not verifiable
findings.fix: Pin to specific SHA digest: FROM node:22-alpine@sha256:<digest> and update via Dependabot

findings.issue: Root package.json may have postinstall scripts that download executables â€” no safety check in CI
findings.impact: Untrusted postinstall scripts could execute arbitrary code during install
findings.fix: Run `pnpm audit --audit-level=high` with block on postinstall scripts, add pnpm config ignore-scripts=true for production installs

findings.issue: Trivy scans only run on push (build-push.yml) â€” not on PRs or scheduled scans for already-deployed images
findings.impact: Vulnerabilities may be introduced between scans; no periodic re-scan of :latest images
findings.fix: Add weekly scheduled Trivy scan against ghcr.io images and PR scan in validate.yml

findings.issue: LiveKit service uses `livekit/livekit-server:latest` tag in both dev and prod â€” mutable tag with no version pinning
findings.impact: Unintentional LiveKit version upgrades on deploy; no rollback to known-good version
findings.fix: Pin livekit/livekit-server to specific version tag (e.g., :1.8.0) in both compose files
